attchmntText: Euro India Fresh Foods Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication in respect of standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Euro India Fresh Foods Limited filed an intimation regarding the newspaper advertisement of the extract of its standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were published in the Financial Express English daily and the Gujarati daily Finance Express on November 09, 2026. The filing was made pursuant to Regulation 30 and 47 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirement Regulations 2015. The document does not contain specific financial figures or voting results. It serves as a routine compliance notice to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The notice was signed by Aniket Ranpara, the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, from Surat. No other material corporate actions or resolutions are detailed in this specific text.

attchmntText: Euro India Fresh Foods Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Euro India Fresh Foods Limited filed a statement regarding the utilization of funds raised through the preferential issue of equity shares and convertible warrants for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The company confirms there is no deviation or variation in the utilization of funds. The statement was reviewed by the Audit Committee and taken on record by the Board of Directors at their meeting held on November 07, 2026.

attchmntText: Euro India Fresh Foods Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Euro India Fresh Foods Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 07, 2026. The Board considered and approved the unaudited financial results along with the Limited Review Report for the quarter and half year ended on September 30, 2026. The meeting commenced at 03.00 p.m. at the registered office in Surat and concluded at 07.15 P.M. The company has enclosed the relevant financial documents with this disclosure.
